newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITV completes three-year Euro soccer deal.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITV completes three-year Euro soccer deal.

text.p: Britain's Independent Television network (ITV) said on Wednesday it had signed a new three-year deal for the exclusive rights to screen the European soccer Champions League.
The network said in a statement the agreement meant it would televise the competition for three years starting from the 1997/98 season.
ITV has screened the Champions League exclusively in Britain since its inception five years ago.
